entities.name: Eleanor Mildred Sidgwick
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eleanor Mildred Sidgwick was a physics researcher assisting Lord Rayleigh, an activist for the higher education of women, Principal of Newnham College of the University of Cambridge, and a leading figure in the Society for Psychical Research.
